statement_en: The series $$\sum_{n\geq 0}\frac{1}{(n+1)(n+2)(n+2)!}$$ converges; that is, the limit of $T_N$ exists.
callout_body: 级数$$\sum_{n\geq 0}\frac{1}{(n+1)(n+2)(n+2)!}$$是收敛的，也就是说$T_N$的极限是存在的。
